blocks.html: If there is one thing all women have in common- that is the love for shopping, be it from simple knick knacks to a precious pair of earrings. As a special treat to all its women patrons, Robinsons Galleria started off its Women’s Month Celebration with the opening of a fashion bazaar located at Level 1, Activity Center where an array of popular women’s brand of clothing, shoes, bags, underwear, and accessories are sold at discounted prices until March 11.

Freebies are also up for grabs. Exciting gifts vouchers from partner shops such as Aerosoles, G2000, Nine West, Parfois, Old Navy, Olympic Gold and Excelsoir Spa await shoppers. Another treat to look forward to during the International Women’s Day is the free 2016 Belle de Jour lifestyle planner. New cardholders of the Robinsons VIP Card shall automatically receive one of the most coveted lifestyle planner upon redemption on March 8 .
